composition: Original 120 BPM upbeat rearrangement: syncopated D-A-F#-E theme, active short bass and light indie-electronic kit.

phrases.name: saving as an active low reply
architecture has the full light groove

sections.name: opening
sections.description: Immediate short motif and playful pickup; opens within the first half-second.

sections.name: personal_habit
sections.description: Syncopated felt keys, octave bass and a light indie groove; no long wash.

sections.name: memory
sections.description: Higher melodic answer and wooden pluck syncopation, with lighter kick variations.

sections.name: cloud
sections.description: Short ascending phrase and a two-bar pickup into the convergence.

sections.name: convergence
sections.description: The brightest rhythmic section: melody develops, bass skips and groove opens, while Foley gets small holes.

sections.name: examples
sections.description: Keep the bass and beat moving, thin the upper melody around nine close message sounds.

sections.name: save_organize
sections.description: Motif and response interlock; short held keys and offbeat plucks follow the organisation movement.

sections.name: capabilities_devices
sections.description: A buoyant refrain, melodic variations and two-voice key stabs; strongest sense of forward movement.

sections.name: security_privacy
sections.description: Still 120 BPM: a light half-time kick, low wooden pulse and warm short harmony, without high shaker chatter.

sections.name: architecture_plan
sections.description: Return of the full light groove and a compact upward reply, no epic crescendo.

sections.name: ending
sections.description: A quick complete motif resolves; new attacks stop at 106.15 and the small Dadd9 tail clears by the end.

performance.instrument_balance: Short felt keys lead. Pluck is a woody offbeat answer; bass skips in short root/fifth/octave gestures. Kick has a light fast body, rim is dry and shaker is soft, never a loud EDM kit.

recommended_envelopes.felt: fast 5–10 ms attack, short note release
recommended_envelopes.pluck: small woody attack; no bell-like long tail
recommended_envelopes.bass: short warm pluck, no sub sustain
recommended_envelopes.pad: about 140 ms attack, short release; background colour rather than a continuous wash
recommended_envelopes.kick: short and light, minimal sub tail
recommended_envelopes.rim: dry narrow transient, not a hand-clap

musical_directions: This is a new arrangement at 120 BPM, not a rate change of the previous 88 BPM audio.
Preserve all approved Foley and all picture timing exactly.
No voice, vocal-like pad, choir, external samples, trailer impacts or triumphal brass.
The strongest lift is convergence and the capability/roadmap refrain; avoid a constant full-volume chorus.
The security passage stays in tempo, retaining a quieter kick/bass/wood pulse without high shaker chatter.
Velocities contain small local reductions around approved close Foley contacts.
Do not apply a slow-down in the ending. Let the last small chord decay and fade by 108.9 seconds.
